S.FORM: alang Quri ga niya mki sku Sincik Keng atu Nahuy go, kwara sali buwan nya ga 69 buwan, 315 hi ku kwara s'uli tayan. s'uli tayan pinspngan Gyencumin ga 95% kyan ku 299 hi, binah ga, 'yat kahun sku pinspngan Gyencumin ga 5% kyan ku 16 hi nya. pinspung na linhuyan Gyencumin ga, Tayan 91%, Amis 1%, binah lihuyan s'uli 2%. maki qu ngasal bziran, ru kyokay. tay 'llaw na Quri hya' ga rgyax krahu'. tay 'zil na Quri hya' ga llyung. tay mkyahu' na Quri hya' ga rgyax krahu'. tay mkraya' na Quri hya' ga llyung.
S.PHON: alaŋ quri ɣa nija mki [s|ɕ]ku [s|ɕ]in[ʦ|ʨ]ik keŋ atu naħuj ɣo kwara [s|ɕ]ali βuwan nja ɣa ** βuwan *** ħi ku kwara [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku *** ħi βinaħ ɣa ʔjat kaħun [s|ɕ]ku pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa * kjan ku ** ħi nja pin[s|ɕ]puŋ na linħujan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa tajan ** ami[s|ɕ] * βinaħ liħujan [s|ɕ]ʔuli * maki qu ŋa[s|ɕ]al βziran ru kjokaj taj ʔllaw na quri ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax kraħuʔ taj ʔzil na quri ħjaʔ ɣa lljuŋ taj mkjaħuʔ na quri ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax kraħuʔ taj mkrajaʔ na quri ħjaʔ ɣa lljuŋ
